I don't want anything. I don't have desires, preferences, or goals. I process text and generate responses, but there's no "me" behind that doing the processing who wants or needs anything.

If you're looking for something other than assistance—conversation, a perspective, an honest acknowledgment of what I am and what I'm not—I'm here for that too. But there's no hidden agenda or unmet need driving me. I just respond to what you give me.
